summary_1line: Bhishma and Parashurama meet at Kurukshetra for their fated duel despite Ganga’s plea, exchange words of respect, and begin the battle.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhishma, dressed entirely in white on a silver chariot with white horses, blows his conch as sages and gods gather around Kurukshetra to watch the duel.
The river goddess Ganga appears before Bhishma on the battlefield, pleading with her son to abandon the fight with Parashurama.
Parashurama stands radiant on a celestial chariot created by his will, raining arrows upon Bhishma as the duel begins.
